blocks.text: CEBU CITY, Philippines—The University of San Carlos (USC) Warriors extended their winning streak to three games after routing the University of San Jose-Recoletos (USJ-R) Jaguars, 69-47, in their rematch in the second round of the Cebu Schools Athletic Foundation, Inc. (Cesafi) Season 26 men’s basketball tournament on Sunday, November 8, at the Cebu Coliseum. The lopsided victory served as sweet revenge for the Warriors, who narrowly lost to the Jaguars, 56-58, in their first-round encounter on October 3. This time, USC made sure there would be no repeat of that outcome, executing its game plan to dominate the Jaguars from start […]...
